description: This file defines the TriState class, which represents a three-state boolean value (True, False, Unknown). It includes constructors for initialization from text or enum, operators for assignment and comparison, and methods to get and set the state. The class is part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace and is likely used for handling tri-state logic within the project.
